title: Troubleshooting Series – Ep2 – Admin Center – Sessions
summary: The Sessions window in the Business Central Admin Center allows partners and delegated admins to view active sessions across all server instances and cancel problematic ones to improve system performance and resolve resource issues.
key_points: Sessions persist after closing tabs or windows, requiring manual management through the Admin Center
The Sessions window displays all active sessions including background tasks and allows cancellation of individual sessions or environment restart
Administrators can cross-reference Database Locks with Sessions to identify which user or process is causing performance issues
Cancelling sessions should be done carefully to avoid incomplete transactions; restart is a last resort for critical situations
Access requires delegated admin role or appropriate Admin Center permissions

quotes.text: sessions are not stopped when you close a tab or window
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why the Sessions window is necessary for managing long-running processes that continue consuming resources after user disconnection

quotes.text: Cancelling a session abruptly can lead to incomplete transactions or data inconsistencies. So make sure you know what you're doing.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the critical best practice of proceeding cautiously when stopping sessions to avoid data integrity issues

quotes.text: Restart is a last resort. It stops all processes so reserve this for critical situations where cancelling individual sessions didn't resolve the issue.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the escalation hierarchy for session management, distinguishing between targeted cancellation and environment-wide restart
